snapViews.defaultProfileUnavailable: Not available on the Default profile, which is either Enhanced Motion or Snap Views. Use a custom Enhanced Motion profile together with a custom Snap Views profile for the same application.
snapViews.noSnapPartner: No enabled Snap Views profile targets this profile’s applications yet.
snapViews.motionNoteNone: An Enhanced Motion profile for the same application can keep working in these Snap Views when it turns on Apply Enhanced Motion to Snap Views.
snapViews.motionNoteSources: Enhanced Motion from {profiles} keeps working in these Snap Views.

conflicts.sharedMessage: This input is assigned to {actions}. A press may trigger multiple actions, or a higher-priority action may shadow another. This warning does not block saving.
conflicts.duplicateMessage: {action} contains the same physical input more than once. The duplicate is redundant and only the first copy is used at runtime.
conflicts.allThreeTitle: One binding controls three conflicting actions
conflicts.allThreeMessage: Activation, Set Origin, and Release Origin all use {binding}. {press} requests a new neutral forward and then immediately clears it, so the origin is not captured. Give Set Origin or Release Origin its own binding.
conflicts.setsOriginMessage: Activation and Set Origin both use {binding}. {press} recaptures the current head direction as Pivot's neutral forward. Keep this only if it is intentional; otherwise give Set Origin its own binding, normally your in-game recenter control.
conflicts.releasesOriginMessage: Activation and Release Origin both use {binding}. {press} clears any captured Pivot origin. Keep this only if it is intentional; otherwise give Release Origin its own binding.
conflicts.setCanceledMessage: Set Origin and Release Origin both use {binding}. A press requests a new neutral forward and then immediately clears it, so the origin is not captured. Give one action a different binding.
